summary: Romania’s NDC combines conservation, restoration and agriculture measures, largely through the EU framework. It reports an EU LULUCF carbon-sinks target of -310 Mt CO2-eq by 2030, also expressed as 310 Mt of net removals, plus an additional 42 Mt CO2-eq above the 2016–2018 average, with remote-sensing monitoring and biodiversity synergies; Romania’s national LULUCF target is -2,380 Kt CO2eq by 2030. The restoration benchmark is at least 20% of EU land areas and 20% of EU sea areas by 2030, with no Romanian area specified. Agriculture targets are 40% of the EU CAP financial allocation for climate objectives in 2023–2027, at least 25% of annual Pillar I direct payments for eco-schemes, and at least 35% of Pillar II funds for environment and climate. Romania’s 235,697 km² is 54.6% agriculture, 34.0% forest and 6.8% grassland; the 20% restoration benchmark is EU-wide, and the finance targets are not area-coverage targets.

targets.context: EU collective target for managed land across the Union; the same commitment is also reported as 310 Mt CO2 net removals.

targets.metric: Additional EU LULUCF net removals versus 2016–2018 average
targets.context: EU-level increase relative to the 2016–2018 average; no Romanian hectare equivalent is specified.
Romania’s listed Member State target for 2030; no conversion to the country’s 80,124 km² forest or 15,911 km² grassland area is stated.

targets.metric: EU land and sea areas under restoration measures
targets.context: EU-wide benchmark; no Romania-specific share of the current 80,124 km² forest or 15,911 km² grassland is specified.

targets.metric: EU CAP financial allocation contributing to climate objectives
targets.context: EU-wide financial share, not a stated coverage percentage of Romania’s 128,623 km² agricultural area.

targets.metric: EU Pillar I direct payments earmarked for eco-schemes
targets.context: Annual EU payment allocation; no corresponding share of Romania’s agricultural area is specified.

targets.metric: EU Pillar II funds dedicated to environment and climate activities
targets.context: EU-wide Pillar II funding share; no Romanian area coverage is stated.
